title: Set up with another device
intro: On a computer that already has Password365, open {place}. Then paste the pairing code it shows here. Both computers must be on the same network.
check: Check that the other device shows the same code, then confirm there:
waiting: Waiting for approval on the other device…
approved: Approved. Enter the master password you use on the other device, and give this device a name. Your items arrive right after.
